concerns.text: The plan cites three parquet files (e.g. `https://huggingface.co/datasets/bio-datasets/dft23-full/resolve/main/data/test-00000-of-00001-a791a8874f9adf69.parquet`) as the *primary* DFT source, but these repositories are not documented to contain 2‑D crystalline materials with complete 6‑component elastic tensors. The dataset name “bio‑datasets” and the generic “dftest” fallbacks raise strong suspicion that the data are unrelated to the target domain (2‑D materials elastic moduli). Since the success criteria (SC‑001, SC‑002) depend on having ≥1 000 valid 2‑D entries with full elastic tensors, using an inappropriate dataset would make the pipeline unable to meet the scientific goals. Replace the cited URLs with a verified 2‑D materials DFT dataset (e.g., Materials Project 2‑D elastic tensor collection or the Open Materials Database 2‑D elastic dataset) that explicitly includes the required columns (`cif`, `elastic_tensor`, `is_2d` flag). Ensure the dataset is reachable, licensed for reuse, and matches the modality (elastic tensors) required by the surrogate model.
